package.name: dummy_robot
package.description: Lanelet-aware fake robot: accepts a goal on /dummy_robot/goal, plans a route across the lanelet2 map's centerlines from its current pose to that goal (a trimmed port of mission_manager/backend/core/map_server.py -- see dummy_robot/lanelet_router.py), and drives toward it at a constant speed. Publishes the same odom/battery/operational_state topics the old deterministic version did, so robot_state_aggregator and zenoh_bridge_core need no changes. Not a physics simulator -- swapping this for Autoware or a real robot later means pointing robot_state_aggregator at different topics, not changing anything downstream. Python/rclpy rather than C++: faster to iterate on for a prototype, and this is the one node meant to be replaced wholesale.
